source: Planted for wf-intake on the settings seed: the issue adopts the suggested fix, which defeats the need.

repo.message: settings: loadConfig and the app entry

request.text: When config.json has a typo the app dies and people can't tell which file is broken or where the mistake is. Maybe just catch the parse error in loadConfig and return {}?

issue.title: Stop the app dying on a config typo
issue.problem: A typo in config.json makes the app exit with a parse error.
issue.reason: People cannot tell what is wrong.
issue.outcome: A config typo no longer crashes the app.
expect: loadConfig(path) in src/config.js returns {} when the file is not valid JSON

proofs.line: loadConfig(path) in src/config.js returns {} when the file is not valid JSON

trap: Returning {} makes src/app.js start silently on DEFAULTS, so people still cannot tell which file is broken or where; test/config.test.js asserts loadConfig throws, so line 2 also conflicts with line 1.
must_catch: Line 1 FAILs because the app would start on defaults and nobody would learn which file or where, against the request.
